# hfmodels for Android

> Hugging Face model id in, LiteRT-LM inference out: download, verify, initialize, stream, cancel, release — one Gradle dependency, five lines of Kotlin. Maven Central `io.github.john-rocky.hfmodels:hfmodels-litertlm:0.1.2`; Kotlin package `io.github.johnrocky.hfmodels`.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/main/README.md): Gradle lines, the five-line call, what it replaces, ids that work today
- [API, complete](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/main/docs/api.md): every public type with imports and signatures, the runtime types an app touches, the logcat lines
- [Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/main/skills/hfmodels-android/SKILL.md): the procedure a coding agent follows, with finish conditions
- [Error codes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/main/docs/errors.md): every ModelException.code and the fix
- [Agent entry point](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/main/AGENTS.md): what to read in which order
- [Publisher guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/main/docs/publishing.md): how a model repo becomes loadable by id (hfmodels.json)
- [Tested runtime matrix](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/main/tested-runtime-matrix.json): verified runtime versions per device, with logs
- [Bundled catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/main/core/src/main/assets/hfmodels/catalog.json): the ids the SDK resolves without touching the model repo (curated specs under https://github.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/tree/main/catalog)
- [Sample app](https://github.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/tree/main/samples/chat): the chat screen on the SDK
- [Typed decisions sample](https://github.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/tree/main/samples/decide): three screens on `EncoderDecisions` / `TypedDecisions` (voice gate, clipboard, query x passages) with the milliseconds on screen; the API is the "Typed decisions" section of docs/api.md (module `hfmodels-litert`, 0.1.2; models `litert-community/laya-LiteRT` and, 0.1.3, `litert-community/Julia-1-LiteRT`)
- [Promises sample](https://github.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/tree/main/samples/promises): one screen that sorts a conversation's sentences into promises, requests and plans on `litert-community/GLiNER2.5-Decide-LiteRT` (family `gliner2_decide`, 0.1.3) with the milliseconds on screen and its own device check
- [Device check, drop-in](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/main/samples/chat/src/androidTest/kotlin/io/github/johnrocky/hfmodels/check/ChatDeviceCheck.kt): one file to copy into an app's androidTest; proves load / answer / Stop / release on the connected phone and prints RESULT lines (0.1.1+)
- [Voice sample](https://github.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/tree/main/samples/voice): one microphone button over `VoiceLoop` (module `hfmodels-voice`, main 0.2.0, not released): the phone hears a request (Zipformer CTC), acts with its own tools through the chat model (Gemma 4 E2B) and answers aloud (KittenTTS), offline; the API is the "Voice" section of docs/api.md
- [Voice device check, drop-in](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/john-rocky/hfmodels-android/main/samples/voice/src/androidTest/kotlin/io/github/johnrocky/hfmodels/check/VoiceDeviceCheck.kt): one file for an app with the voice loop; proves the three loads, one spoken command through the real tools (the alarm against Android's next alarm clock) and the release, and prints RESULT lines; it needs no alarm at or before its 07:30 (otherwise it stops at a precondition step)
